create_scale_image: scale the short side of an image to a specified size using cv2 resize
create_random_crop: perform random crop on a list of images with optional padding and bounding box support
create_color_jitter: apply random brightness, contrast, and saturation jitter to images
create_horizontal_flip: horizontally flip images and corresponding bounding boxes with a given probability
create_lighting_jitter: perform AlexNet-style PCA lighting jitter on images using eigenvalues and eigenvectors
